nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 _token: the ERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable address _beneficiary: recipient of the tokens after release.
Immutable uint256 _releaseTime: timestamp after which tokens can be released.
constructor(IERC20 token_, address beneficiary_, uint256 releaseTime_): validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and stores immutable state.
token(): view function returning the held ERC20 token (_token).
beneficiary(): view function returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary).
releaseTime(): view function returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime).
release(): checks block.timestamp against releaseTime(), reads the token balance of this contract and transfers it to the beneficiary using safeTransfer.
getLockedAmount(): view function returning the token balance currently locked in the contract.
block.timestamp used in constructor require: releaseTime_ must be greater than the current block timestamp.
block.timestamp used in release() require: current time must be at or after releaseTime().
token().safeTransfer(beneficiary(), amount): external token transfer via low-level call in release().
token().balanceOf(address(this)): external call to the token contract used in release() and getLockedAmount().
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ (uint256) checked against block.timestamp and assigned to _releaseTime.
Local variable amount in release(): token balance of the contract passed as transfer value.
Local variable amount in getLockedAmount(): token balance of the contract returned by the view function.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is written into immutable state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is written into immutable state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is written into immutable state variable _releaseTime.
releaseTime_ is compared against block.timestamp in the constructor require, creating timestamp dependency.
releaseTime() is called inside release() to perform the timelock check.
token() is called inside release() to obtain the token contract used for balance and transfer.
beneficiary() is called inside release() to determine the recipient.
release() performs an external token transfer (safeTransfer) to the beneficiary, enabling reentrancy into the token/external contract.
beneficiary() address is used as the recipient of safeTransfer.
Local variable amount is passed as the value of safeTransfer.
release() calls token().balanceOf(address(this)) through the external balanceOf operation.
getLockedAmount() calls token().balanceOf(address(this)) through the external balanceOf operation.
Local variable amount is returned by getLockedAmount().

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is only used to initialize state variable _token inside the constructor and should be normalized into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only used to initialize state variable _beneficiary inside the constructor and should be normalized into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is validated against block.timestamp and stored into _releaseTime within the constructor, so it merges into the constructor.
Local variable amount in release() is a transient balance value forwarded directly to the safeTransfer operation and can be merged into the release function node.
Local variable amount in getLockedAmount() is a transient balance value immediately returned and can be merged into the getLockedAmount function node.
